clause: Vector live effects - Convert-to-Shape + Crop Marks [STU-FX-027]

scope.summary: Implement the Convert-to-Shape live effects (V,T,G; CPU/No-GPU) that live-convert an object silhouette without destroying source geometry: Convert to Rectangle (absolute/relative size), Convert to Rounded Rectangle (corner radius), Convert to Ellipse (absolute/relative size), plus Crop Marks (live crop marks around object bounds as an appearance effect). Re-editable stack entries, bake-expandable.
acceptance_criteria: Convert to Rectangle, Convert to Rounded Rectangle, Convert to Ellipse, Crop Marks
expected_tests: test: silhouette converts to rectangle/rounded-rect/ellipse by absolute+relative size; Crop Marks track bounds; source preserved

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
